It's not a workaround, apparently it's built this way by design

https://github.com/PyCQA/pylint/blob/44a3d96e1af985c6ad290a51555b9c7ced0a7079/pylint/pyreverse/main.py#L174-L182

issue.title: Support multiple separate arguments for —ignore

repository.name: pylint
repository.description: It's not just a linter that annoys you!

issue.body:
### Current problem

A user specifying multiple `—ignore` arguments will only find the last one is accepted. This deviates from a more orthodox expectation of specifying multiple arguments of a certain kind that follow `nargs` type of behavior.

### Desired solution

Specify ignore entries to behave jointly as a union across distinct ignore arguments just like described in https://docs.python.org/3/library/argparse.html#nargs

### Additional context

Also discussed in issue  #564
